analysis: 3D linear static elasticity, Q2 isoparametric hexahedra, 3x3x3 Gauss integration; scipy sparse direct solve
geometry: STEP is the entire 100 x 5 x 50 mm plate with exact analytic radius-10 cylindrical through hole parallel to y
symmetry_reduction: Mesh is y=0..2.5 and z=25..50, exact one-quarter reduction. uy=0 at y=2.5; uz=0 at z=25. Reflect through these planes with odd normal displacement and even tangential displacements to recover full solution. No x symmetry imposed.
boundary_conditions: x=0 all displacement components fixed; x=100 uniform tx=4 MPa (1000 N / 250 mm^2), quarter resultant 250 N; other non-symmetry faces traction-free.
extraction: At all 27 local Q2 nodes compute stress from displacement derivatives using isoparametric Jacobians. Average the six tensor components equally over incident elements at a shared node, then calculate von Mises and take global maximum. Integration-point and unaveraged maxima are also recorded for diagnostics.

field_schema.node_ids: Gmsh 1-based node tags, all quadratic nodes
field_schema.element_local_node_ids: E x 27, skfem Q2 local sample nodes in same order as element_local_stress
field_schema.element_local_stress_MPa: E x 27 x 6, one-sided element-node stress tensors
field_schema.gauss_stress_MPa: E x 27 x 6, unrecovered integration-point tensors
field_schema.*_mask: N Boolean physical boundary node masks

assumptions: Full thickness response retained; no plane-stress approximation.
STEP hole analytic; analysis uses converging quadratic interpolation of the cylindrical boundary.
